title: Moving the data directory needs the old base in adopt.js
body:
Add the previous location to the bases adoptHistory searches in src/store/adopt.js in the same change. A new index adopts this project's telemetry, observations and contradiction log only from locations listed there; any other old path is abandoned silently, because atoms return from git and the store still looks complete.

Why: The data directory moved three times (~/.supermem, ~/.dd, ~/.dd-data) and telemetry was split across them until adoptHistory was added on 2026-09-22; adoption is list-driven, so a fourth move without updating the list repeats the silent loss.

evidence.summary: adoptHistory copies rows from a fixed list of bases (~/.dd-data, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA, GROK_PLUGIN_DATA) plus known legacy locations.
Gap 6 records the three moves and the split telemetry that motivated adoption.

v1.trigger: when changing where DD keeps its per-project data (dataBase in src/project.js, DD_DATA handling, plugin data variables)
